capabilities: Create scrollytelling journals that sync narrative scrolling to an animated topographic map
Build a personal world atlas of trips with fly-to navigation and travel stats
Assign photos to map locations manually or via AI location detection
Generate journals through a 5-step wizard from GPX files, photos, and written sections
Browse all journals in a timeline sidebar grouped by year with search
extras: Journals are stored as plain Markdown files in the vault with no cloud dependency. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Trip photos, GPX files, and written memories stay in separate places, and stitching them into a story with a route map is tedious.

relations.evidence: The scrollytelling design of HikerScrolls is inspired by Koya Bound by Craig Mod
HikerScrolls integrates with Google Gemini to help you build journals faster

summary: Scrollytelling travel journal that turns GPX tracks and photos into scroll-driven map narratives plus a personal world atlas of trips.
